title: SECOND AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 23-9953 WITH ICF INCORPORATED, L.L.C. DBA ICF CONSULTING, L.L.C.; AGREEMENT NO. 23-9955 WITH STARCREST CONSULTING GROUP, LLC; AND AGREEMENT NO. 23-9956 WITH TETRA TEC
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - SECOND AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 23-9953 WITH ICF INCORPORATED, L.L.C. DBA ICF CONSULTING, L.L.C.; AGREEMENT NO. 23-9955 WITH STARCREST CONSULTING GROUP, LLC; AND AGREEMENT NO. 23-9956 WITH TETRA TECH, INC. FOR AS-NEEDED AIR QUALITY SERVICES
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Transmittal 3
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the proposed three Second Amendments (Amendments) to Personal Service Agreements (Agreements) with ICF Incorporated, L.L.C. dba ICF Consulting, L.L.C. (ICF) (Agreement No. 23-9953), Starcrest Consulting Group, LLC (Starcrest) (Agreement No. 23-9955), and Tetra Tech, Inc. (Tetra Tech) (Agreement No. 23-9956) that provide the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) technical support for air quality programs. If the proposed Amendments are approved, the contract authority will increase by $500,000 for ICF, $1,000,000 for Starcrest, and $350,000 for Tetra Tech to provide support for new and ongoing projects. The Harbor Department will continue to be financially responsible for the payment of services received under these Agreements. These Agreements are in alignment with Strategic Objective 2: An Efficient, Secure, and Sustainable Supply Chain.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that in accordance with the City of Los Angeles (City) Charter Section 1022, work under the subject Agreements can be performed more feasibly by independent consultants rather than by City employees; 3) approve the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 23-9953 with ICF Incorporated, L.L.C. dba ICF Consulting, L.L.C. to increase the contract amount by $500,000 for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $1,000,000; 4) approve the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 23-9955 with Starcrest Consulting Group, LLC to increase the contract amount by $1,000,000 for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $4,100,000; 5) approve the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 23-9956 with Tetra Tech, Inc. to increase the contract amount by $350,000 for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $2,850,000; 6) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to said Amendments for and on behalf of the Board; 7) direct the Board Secretary to transmit the Amendments to the City Council for approval pursuant to Section 373 of the Charter of the City of Los Angeles; and 8) adopt Resolution No. _________.
